verdict.rationale: Otter AI Chat and its enterprise MCP server explicitly support natural-language querying across meeting history ('what did we decide about pricing?'-style questions), searching transcripts across all time periods, analyzing patterns across meetings, and citing/linking back to source meetings via the AI Chat interface. This is corroborated by a live runtime probe confirming the MCP endpoint is real and OAuth-gated, not vaporware. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of answer accuracy/quality and explicit confirmation that answers include inline source citations (docs describe search/analysis but don't detail citation format in depth).
